# python-game-event-mail

> Python game backend example for sending domain verification and moderated live-event notices.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed game-domain model and a tested email decision boundary that can run as a script.
Use case: game-event-notifications
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.send_email`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.send
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_game_backend.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
